lessons.title: Algorithmic and Automated Trading Fundamentals
lessons.description: Separate strategy rules, signal generation, risk checks, order submission, and execution, then choose the appropriate level of automation.

lessons.title: Trading System Architecture and Components
lessons.description: Define the services, boundaries, data stores, messages, and ownership required to move from market data to an auditable trading decision.

lessons.title: Market Data Ingestion and Normalization
lessons.description: Receive historical and streaming data, validate timestamps and symbols, remove duplicates, handle late events, and expose one normalized market-data model.

lessons.title: Time, Sessions, Events, and Scheduling
lessons.description: Use exchange calendars, time zones, session boundaries, event windows, and deterministic schedulers instead of assuming every day and minute is tradable.

lessons.title: Signal Engine and Strategy State
lessons.description: Convert normalized events into deterministic strategy-state transitions while preventing repeated, contradictory, or stale signals.

lessons.title: Portfolio, Position, and Risk Engine
lessons.description: Maintain authoritative cash, positions, exposure, open orders, and risk limits before any order is submitted.

lessons.title: Broker APIs and Order Lifecycle
lessons.description: Submit, query, cancel, and reconcile orders through a broker adapter while treating every response and status update as asynchronous state.

lessons.title: Order Management and Execution
lessons.description: Select order types, manage open orders, control participation, and measure fill quality against the decision price and available liquidity.

lessons.title: Paper Trading and Forward Testing
lessons.description: Run the complete system on current market data without live capital, then compare backtest assumptions with observed signals, latency, and simulated fills.

lessons.title: Scanners, Alerts, and Human Approval
lessons.description: Screen instruments, rank candidates, deduplicate alerts, communicate the exact thesis, and expire decisions that are no longer current.

lessons.title: Reliability, Idempotency, Retries, and Recovery
lessons.description: Design duplicate-safe commands, bounded retries, durable state, reconciliation, and restart behavior for uncertain networks and asynchronous broker updates.

lessons.title: Observability, Logging, and Auditability
lessons.description: Measure data freshness, decision latency, broker latency, error rate, positions, risk, and end-to-end traces while preserving an immutable decision audit trail.

lessons.title: Security, Secrets, Permissions, and Kill Switches
lessons.description: Protect broker credentials, restrict execution permissions, separate environments, audit access, rotate secrets, and provide immediate mechanisms to stop new trading.

lessons.title: Deployment, Environments, and Configuration
lessons.description: Build reproducible artifacts, separate development, paper, and live configuration, validate changes, deploy gradually, and roll back without changing trading state unexpectedly.

lessons.title: AI-Assisted and Agentic Trading Workflows
lessons.description: Use AI for research, extraction, classification, and trade proposals while keeping market data, rules, risk, permissions, and execution controls deterministic and auditable.

lessons.title: Automated Trading System Specification and Production Readiness
lessons.description: Combine strategy, data, architecture, risk, broker, reliability, security, deployment, observability, approval, and rollback requirements into one versioned production specification.
